invariant: i ≤ len ∧ r.size = dest.size ∧ (∀ k, k < dStart → r[k]! = dest[k]!) ∧ (∀ k, dStart + i ≤ k → k < r.size → r[k]! = dest[k]!) ∧ (∀ k, k < i → r[dStart + k]! = src[sStart + k]!)

lemmas.name: set_bang_get
lemmas.statement: ∀ (r : Array Int) (p : Nat) (v : Int) (k : Nat), p < r.size → (r.set! p v)[k]! = if p = k then v else r[k]!
lemmas.proof:
by intro r p v k hp
  rw [Array.set!_eq_setIfInBounds]
  by_cases hk : k < r.size
  · have hk' : k < (r.setIfInBounds p v).size := by simpa using hk
    rw [getElem!_pos (r.setIfInBounds p v) k hk', getElem!_pos r k hk, Array.getElem_setIfInBounds hk]
  · have h1 : ¬ k < (r.setIfInBounds p v).size := by simpa using hk
    rw [getElem!_neg (r.setIfInBounds p v) k h1, getElem!_neg r k hk]
    split
    · omega
    · rfl

lemmas.name: step56
lemmas.statement: ∀ (src dest r : Array Int) (sStart dStart len i : Nat), copy_precond src sStart dest dStart len → i < len → (i ≤ len ∧ r.size = dest.size ∧ (∀ k, k < dStart → r[k]! = dest[k]!) ∧ (∀ k, dStart + i ≤ k → k < r.size → r[k]! = dest[k]!) ∧ (∀ k, k < i → r[dStart + k]! = src[sStart + k]!)) → (i + 1 ≤ len ∧ (r.set! (dStart + i) src[sStart + i]!).size = dest.size ∧ (∀ k, k < dStart → (r.set! (dStart + i) src[sStart + i]!)[k]! = dest[k]!) ∧ (∀ k, dStart + (i + 1) ≤ k → k < (r.set! (dStart + i) src[sStart + i]!).size → (r.set! (dStart + i) src[sStart + i]!)[k]! = dest[k]!) ∧ (∀ k, k < i + 1 → (r.set! (dStart + i) src[sStart + i]!)[dStart + k]! = src[sStart + k]!))
lemmas.proof:
by intro src dest r sStart dStart len i hpre hi hinv
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hpre
  obtain ⟨_, hs, ha, hb, hc⟩ := hinv
  have hp : dStart + i < r.size := by omega
  have hsz : (r.set! (dStart + i) src[sStart + i]!).size = r.size := Array.size_set! _ _ _
  refine ⟨by omega, by rw [hsz]; exact hs, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k hk
    rw [set_bang_get r _ _ k hp, if_neg (by omega)]; exact ha k hk
  · intro k hk hk2
    rw [hsz] at hk2
    rw [set_bang_get r _ _ k hp, if_neg (by omega)]; exact hb k (by omega) hk2
  · intro k hk
    rw [set_bang_get r _ _ _ hp]
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · subst hki; simp
    · rw [if_neg (by omega)]; exact hc k (by omega)

lemmas.name: exit56
lemmas.statement: ∀ (src dest r : Array Int) (sStart dStart len i : Nat) (h : copy_precond src sStart dest dStart len), (i ≤ len ∧ r.size = dest.size ∧ (∀ k, k < dStart → r[k]! = dest[k]!) ∧ (∀ k, dStart + i ≤ k → k < r.size → r[k]! = dest[k]!) ∧ (∀ k, k < i → r[dStart + k]! = src[sStart + k]!)) → ¬ i < len → copy_postcond src sStart dest dStart len r h
lemmas.proof:
by intro src dest r sStart dStart len i h hinv hn
  obtain ⟨hi, hs, ha, hb, hc⟩ := hinv
  have hi' : i = len := by omega
  subst hi'
  unfold copy_postcond
  exact ⟨hs, ha, hb, hc⟩
